title: LLM Context & State Management
summary: This module provides core functions for managing the internal state of the LLM inference context, including saving, loading, and querying context and sequence data. It also offers utilities for performance monitoring, memory usage analysis, and parameter optimization.

nodes.label: Copy Context State Data
nodes.title: Copy LLM Context State
nodes.description: Duplicates the entire internal state of the LLM context into a provided memory buffer.

nodes.label: Restore Context State Data
nodes.title: Restore LLM Context State
nodes.description: Overwrites the current LLM context state with data from a source memory buffer.

nodes.label: Load Session Tokens
nodes.title: Load LLM Session from File
nodes.description: Reads and applies previously saved session tokens from a file to the LLM context.

nodes.label: Save Session Tokens
nodes.title: Save LLM Session to File
nodes.description: Writes the current LLM session's tokens to a specified file for persistent storage.

nodes.label: Retrieve Sequence Data
nodes.title: Get Specific Sequence State
nodes.description: Fetches the internal state data for a designated sequence within the LLM context.

nodes.label: Apply Sequence Data
nodes.title: Set Specific Sequence State
nodes.description: Updates the internal state of a designated sequence using provided data.

nodes.label: Query Total State Size
nodes.title: Get Full Context State Size
nodes.description: Calculates the total memory footprint of the entire LLM context's internal state.

nodes.label: Query Sequence Size
nodes.title: Get Specific Sequence State Size
nodes.description: Determines the memory size required to store the state of a particular sequence.

nodes.label: Save Sequence to File
nodes.title: Persist Sequence State
nodes.description: Stores the state and tokens of a specific sequence to a file.

nodes.label: Load Sequence from File
nodes.title: Restore Sequence State
nodes.description: Loads and integrates a saved sequence state from a file into the LLM context.

nodes.label: Display Performance Stats
nodes.title: Show LLM Performance
nodes.description: Presents detailed performance metrics, including processing times and token rates, for the LLM operations.

nodes.label: Display Memory Usage
nodes.title: Show Memory Breakdown
nodes.description: Generates a comprehensive report on memory allocation and usage across various hardware components.

nodes.label: Optimize Model Memory
nodes.title: Adjust Model for Memory Fit
nodes.description: Attempts to modify model and context parameters to ensure efficient memory utilization on the device.

groups.label: Context State Management
groups.title: LLM Context State Management
groups.description: Functions for copying, restoring, and querying the overall state of the LLM inference context.

groups.label: Session & Sequence Persistence
groups.title: LLM Session & Sequence Handling
groups.description: Functions dedicated to managing the state of individual sequences and entire sessions, including data retrieval, application, and file-based saving/loading.

groups.label: Diagnostics & Optimization
groups.title: Performance & Resource Tools
groups.description: Utilities for monitoring LLM performance, analyzing memory usage, and optimizing model parameters for resource constraints.
